test_is_list_like: test the inference.is_list_like function to check if objects like lists, tuples, dicts, iterators, and numpy arrays are list-like
test_is_dict_like: test the inference.is_dict_like function to verify duck-typed objects with keys, __getitem__, and __contains__ are dict-like
test_is_hashable: test the inference.is_hashable function to check which objects are hashable including slices and numpy arrays
test_is_file_like: test the inference.is_file_like function to verify objects with read or write attributes are file-like
test_is_named_tuple: test the inference.is_named_tuple function to check collections.namedtuple instances against regular tuples
test_infer_dtype: test the lib.infer_dtype function to infer types like integer, floating, boolean, datetime, timedelta, string, and mixed from object arrays
test_maybe_convert_objects: test the lib.maybe_convert_objects function to convert object arrays to typed numpy arrays including datetime, timedelta, nullable integer, and boolean
test_maybe_convert_numeric: test the lib.maybe_convert_numeric function to convert string arrays to numeric types handling infinities, scientific notation, and overflow
test_maybe_convert_bool: test the libops.maybe_convert_bool function to convert boolean arrays with NaN values to masked nullable BooleanArray or object array
test_isposinf_isneginf: test the libmissing.isposinf_scalar and isneginf_scalar functions to check positive and negative infinity values
test_is_scalar: test the is_scalar function to verify scalars like None, booleans, numbers, strings, datetime objects, and numpy scalars while excluding containers
test_is_number: test the is_number function to check if objects are numeric including numpy scalar types while excluding booleans and datetime objects
test_is_integer: test the is_integer function to verify integer detection for Python ints and numpy integer types while excluding booleans and floats
test_is_float: test the is_float function to check float detection for Python floats and numpy float types while excluding integers and booleans
test_is_datetime_dtypes: test the is_datetime64_dtype, is_datetime64_ns_dtype, is_datetime64_any_dtype, and is_datetime64tz_dtype functions for datetime dtype checking
test_find_result_type: test the find_result_type function to determine the result dtype for binary operations between different integer, float, and datetime types
test_is_list_like_iter_none: test that inference.is_list_like returns False for objects with __iter__ set to None to avoid false positives
test_is_list_like_generic: test that inference.is_list_like correctly handles Generic subclasses of DataFrame in Python 3.11+
test_is_list_like_native_container: test that inference.is_list_like returns False for native container types like list[int] and tuple[str]
